# Roadmap

Planned work after v0.1.0. Each item is written up as a ready-to-file issue,
with acceptance criteria, in [docs/ISSUES_TO_FILE.md](../docs/ISSUES_TO_FILE.md).
Items marked *good first issue* are well scoped for new contributors.

| # | Item | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | XGBoost/LightGBM model option behind an optional extra | good first issue |
| 2 | `amesml explain` with SHAP explanations of individual predictions | good first issue |
| 3 | Hyperparameter search with `amesml tune` (Optuna) | enhancement |
| 4 | Cross-validation report with confidence intervals | enhancement |
| 5 | Dataset adapters for the Kaggle `test.csv` and the full De Cock data | enhancement |
| 6 | Streamlit demo app (`amesml demo`) | good first issue |
| 7 | Model registry: list and compare saved models | enhancement |
| 8 | Tutorial notebook: "From notebook to package" | docs |
| 9 | Publish the Docker image to GHCR on release | ci |
| 10 | Drift check comparing incoming batches with the training data | enhancement |

Have another idea? Open a [feature request](https://github.com/Ahsan-muhd-444/house-price-prediction/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml).
